description: We are a team of Grade 10 (MYP 5) students passionate about AI, coding, space science, and innovation. With strong interests in programming, scientific research, and problem-solving, we enjoy building technology-driven solutions to complex challenges. For NASA Space Apps 2026, we're taking on Flame in Freefall, combining AI and software development to explore microgravity combustion research and make scientific insights more accessible. We're excited to push our technical abilities further!
